verdict.rationale: Adyen documents that its ML risk engine scores transactions using Adyen's global transaction data. Marketing copy says Protect scores every transaction against trillions of global data points, spotting fraudsters from their very first visit, and risk lists can draw on Adyen's own data. Shopper DNA links shoppers into networks, which supports the network-informed scoring the story describes. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that a card or identity's history at other merchants feeds a given merchant's score, detail on how cross-merchant signals are weighted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, scoring benefits from a cross-merchant network — a card or identity seen across thousands of other businesses informs the risk decision on mine

citations.quote: Our risk engine uses machine learning and Adyen's global transaction data to evaluate the fraud risk of transactions.
Protect's AI scores every transaction against trillions of global data points — spotting trusted shoppers and fraudsters, from their very first visit.
By combining transaction data points, shopper DNA uncovers the networks that connect individual shoppers.
